interface.title: Minimalist Image Annotation (franchesoni/minimalist-annotation, index.html)
interface.stage_of_work: Data preparation: building annotated training sets for detection and interactive segmentation
interface.what_it_is_for: A single-page tool that runs entirely in the browser: load a batch of images, mark objects with bounding boxes or positive/negative click points, add a free-text note for each image, and export everything as one JSON file keyed by image filename.

data.note: Uploaded both test images ('17344352-group-of-multiple-objects-isolated-on-white-background-illustration.jpg', a 5x5 grid of clip-art objects, and 'centaurus.jpeg', a photo of a statue) through the patched multi-file 'Select Folder' input. The exported annotations.json was downloaded twice and read back. It could not be given back to 'Load Annotations', because only the two test images can be uploaded.

tree.specific: Annotate a folder of images with bounding boxes and positive/negative points plus a text description, then save one annotations.json keyed by filename

features.name: Pan/zoom image canvas with crosshair and image-space annotation coordinates
features.general: View one image on a canvas you can zoom and drag, with a full-height crosshair cursor, and record clicks in original image pixel coordinates whatever the zoom
features.specific: Wheel to zoom about the cursor (modest steps, about 1.2x after two scrolls), left-drag to pan, red crosshair lines follow the mouse, Reset View fits the image back; boxes and points stay registered to the image
steps: scroll the wheel over the region of interest to zoom in
left-drag to pan to the object
place points or boxes while zoomed
press Reset View to fit the whole image and check the placement
serves_tasks: Zoom and pan to place precise annotations on small objects
Draw a bounding box around each object of interest
Mark foreground and background points on an object as weak supervision for segmentation

features.name: Two-click bounding box tool with live preview
features.general: Draw a rectangle by clicking one corner and then the opposite corner, with a preview rectangle while choosing the second corner
features.specific: Bounding Box Mode: the first left click anchors the box, a pink preview follows the cursor, the second click commits a green box saved as {x1,y1,x2,y2,type:'bbox'}; a drag in between pans without breaking the box
steps: press Switch to Bounding Box Mode
left-click one corner of the object
move to the opposite corner and watch the pink preview
left-click to commit the green box
repeat for each object
serves_tasks: Draw a bounding box around each object of interest

features.name: Positive/negative point prompts
features.general: Mark points inside an object (include) and outside it (exclude) with two mouse buttons, as click prompts for interactive segmentation
features.specific: Point Mode: left click puts a green positive point, right click a red negative point, each saved as {imgX,imgY,type}; can be combined with a box on the same image
steps: press Switch to Point Mode
left-click on the object for positive points
right-click on the background for negative points
optionally add a box around the same object in Bounding Box Mode
serves_tasks: Mark foreground and background points on an object as weak supervision for segmentation

features.name: Annotation removal: Undo, middle-click delete, Clear
features.general: Remove the last mark, one chosen mark, or all marks on the current image
features.specific: Undo button pops the last entry in the image's list, which is usually the last box or point but can be the description entry if that was last; a middle click on a box corner/edge deletes that box (a middle click inside it does nothing); Clear empties the image's annotations and description. Ctrl+Z does not undo annotations: it goes through the textbox's browser edit history and can carry one image's old text into another image's box
steps: press Undo to drop the last annotation (check the description is still there)
middle-click a box corner to delete that box
press Clear to wipe the whole image

features.name: Per-image annotation state with Previous/Next and keyboard navigation
features.general: Step through a set of items while each one keeps its own marks and note
features.specific: Previous/Next buttons (and A/D/arrow keys) switch images; each filename keeps its own boxes, points and description text, which come back when you return. The A/D keys are not suppressed while the description box has focus, so typing 'a' or 'd' there switches image
steps: annotate the current image
click outside the description box, then press Next or D
annotate the next image
press Previous or A and check the first image's marks and text are back
serves_tasks: Navigate between images and confirm each kept its own annotations
Import a batch of images and confirm they all loaded

features.name: Per-image free-text description
features.general: Attach a free-text note to the current item, kept with it and exported with its annotations
features.specific: Textbox under the canvas; the text is stored once per image as {type:'desc', description}, empty for a new image and brought back on navigation. Bug: the A/D shortcuts fire while typing, so a word containing 'a' or 'd' jumps to another image mid-word and writes the rest into that image's description (replay: typing 'centaur' on image 2 left 'cent' there and put the rest into image 1)
steps: type a class name or note in the textbox, checking it stays on the current image
navigate away and back to check it was kept
save to see it as a 'desc' entry in the JSON
serves_tasks: Attach a free-text note (class label or comment)

features.name: JSON export/import of all annotations keyed by filename
features.general: Save every item's annotations to one portable file and reload it later to continue
features.specific: Save Annotations downloads annotations.json mapping each image filename to its list of points, boxes and description in image pixels (verified). Load Annotations is meant to read such a file; only its rejection of a non-JSON file was seen (alert text from the replay note, not visible on screen), and restoring from a valid file was not reached
steps: press Save Annotations
open annotations.json and check each filename's entries
later press Load Annotations and pick the JSON to restore the work (not verified in this run)
serves_tasks: Export all annotations to one file keyed by image name
Reload saved annotations to resume work
